data.body:
[P2] Preserve live causes on wrappers carrying an ErrorObject

A non-null `ErrorObject` does not imply there is no live cause: both SDK wrapper classes accept both values. In particular, `ExecutionManager.signalContinuationFailure` constructs `UnrecoverableDurableExecutionException(errorObject, true, failure)`, which reaches invocation-end telemetry in `ON_CHANGE` mode. This guard omits the actual failure and its nested causes, leaving the generic checkpoint-continuation message. Remove the early return so name/message still come from `ErrorObject` while any live cause passes through the existing depth/cycle guards. Add tests for wrappers containing both an `ErrorObject` and a cause.
